The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''2500 before the Battle of Yavin''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[Inter-Sith Wars period|era]] between the [[Old Sith Wars]] and the [[New Sith Wars]]. Around that time, prospectors discovered that the core of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] has fused [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] and [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] into [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gems]], sparking a mining rush that dies out less than a century later. Also around that time, the main hall of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] is constructed in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. That iteration of the Archives remains unchanged for 2,500 [[Standard year/Legends|years]].
